# Bundle Attestations

This directory holds supply chain attestation files for the OPA policy bundle.

## Files

- `cosign.bundle.json` — Sigstore/Cosign bundle for bundle verification
- `slsa-provenance.json` — SLSA provenance attestation

These files are generated during the CI/CD bundle build process using:

```bash
# Sign the bundle
cosign sign-blob --bundle attestations/cosign.bundle.json bundle.tar.gz

# Generate SLSA provenance (via CI pipeline)
# slsa-provenance is auto-generated by the build system
```
